description: This file defines the Google OAuth2 provider class, extending an abstract provider class. It includes methods for constructing authorization URLs, access token URLs, user info URLs, handling authorization parameters, scope management, response checking, and creating user resource objects. It also manages domain validation for hosted domains.

classes.name: Google
classes.description: Represents the Google OAuth2 provider with methods to generate URLs, handle parameters, validate responses, and create user resource objects.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL used to begin the OAuth2 authorization flow.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for obtaining an access token from Google.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to fetch user info using the access token.

methods.name: getAuthorizationParameters
methods.description: Prepares and returns authorization parameters, merging default scopes and custom options.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Returns default OAuth scopes required for OpenID Connect.

methods.name: getScopeSeparator
methods.description: Returns the separator used for scope strings.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Checks the API response for errors and throws exceptions if needed.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates a user resource object from the response data.

methods.name: assertMatchingDomain
methods.description: Validates that the hosted domain matches the configured domain criteria; throws an exception if not.
